name: Alphastar
note: Version 1.0.69 / build 70 adds the Alphastar Support (System Message) label and S acknowledgement-typing avatar, with balanced patient feedback cards and actions. Matching desktop/backend sources deliver protected live chat invalidations for Dashboard badges, retain a polling/older-backend fallback, add separate loaded current/history search and improve dropdown keyboard controls and confirmation layout. Private message bodies are not sent through the clinic event stream. Website Back/minimize preserves the page's guest conversation; refresh/page exit ends it. Registered mobile conversations remain saved across exit/logout. The Help Bot transcript and booking details are not automatically shared. Physical-phone installation and actual notification delivery are not verified. Existing development signing certificate retained; not Play Store or production-signing approval.
